args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel insurance information

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes/sandals for beach activities
- Hiking shoes/boots for Diamond Head
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking gear for Diamond Head
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Trail snacks
- Small backpack/daypack
- Insect repellent

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication (for boat trips)
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer

ELECTRONICS:
- Camera (mentioned in original list)
- Phone
- Chargers for all devices
- Universal adapter if needed
- Waterproof case for electronics

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for travel days
- Book/e-reader for relaxation time
- Travel pillow for flights
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach toys, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles, energy bars
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress if desired
- June 17 (Spa day): Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothing
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags
